title: Rabbi Yaakov, Son of Rabbi Chanina, a Tanna of a Baraita

paragraphs: Rabbi Yaakov son of Rabbi Chanina. (Tanna of a baraita).

Shabbat 79b describes a tannaitic dispute: “If he changed in either case, it is invalid; Rabbi Acha declares it valid in the name of Rabbi Yaakov son of Rabbi Chanina.” In Sifrei, Haazinu, on “Yaarof,” he says to Rabbi: “Come, let us examine the laws, so they do not rust.” In Avot de-Rabbi Natan, chapter 29, he says: “One who lies awake at night and does not open his mouth with words of Torah deserves that his mother’s afterbirth should have turned over upon his face.”

notes.text: The checked Shabbat text gives Yaakov son of Rabbi Chanina as an alternative to Achai bar Chanina. Hyman quotes the Yaakov attribution.

The Shabbat passage gives Achai bar Chanina and Yaakov son of Rabbi Chanina as alternatives. The subjects of the Sifrei and Avot de-Rabbi Natan sayings follow Hyman’s framing; this does not independently establish identity across the citations.
